summary.name: Kap
summary.one_liner: Kap is an open-source screen recorder built with web technology that exports captures as GIF, MP4, WebM, or APNG.
use_cases: creating GIFs for blog posts or docs
exporting short screen clips as video
summary.what_it_does: Kap records the screen and exports the result as GIF, MP4, WebM, or APNG. It supports optional audio, can highlight mouse clicks, and lets you trim recordings. The page says it is built with web technology and is extensible through plugins. The source is on GitHub under the wulkano organization, and it is listed as open source in the awesome-mac directory.
notable: Open source, with source code on GitHub (wulkano/kap)
Exports GIF, MP4, WebM, and APNG
caveats: Platform support beyond macOS is not stated on the page
Page does not describe pricing or licensing terms beyond open source listing
